propositions: Snapshot GC (janitor) runs only in the review-bot process; every other host's snapshot store is append-only and never reclaimed, causing unbounded disk growth (64k+ entries, 47+ GiB measured).

An operation-linked trigger must be added to reclaim snapshots on attested gate resolution on non-review-bot hosts, following the detached-child pattern from compact_trigger to avoid long-lock pitfalls.

The trigger check on gate-resolution tail must be O(1) (one stat of a timestamp marker), hold no ticket-store lock, never raise, and never affect the hot path; the heavy GC pass runs detached and off-process.

Single-flight semantics via stamped worker-lock sidecars keyed on the per-host snapshot store root, with overlap against the review-bot's resident janitor gracefully degrading to skipped and not resetting the cadence clock.
A detached child spawned by the trigger runs the existing run_gc policy under its own gc flock, with durable cwd anchored at the snapshot store root (POSIX-only; win32 no-op).
